page_title: WOL 0-2 BRE | Wolves v Brentford 10/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+8' Matt Doherty (Wolves) manages a fine header towards goal, but it misses the target as the ball flies past the right post.
90+7' The attendance is 30731.
90+6' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
90+5' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) sends a cross into the box, but Mark Flekken comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+3' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) serves up a nice cross, but Mark Flekken punches the ball away.
90+2' Ethan Pinnock (Brentford) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
88' Simon Hooper shows a yellow card to Mario Lemina (Wolves) for his blatant foul.
88' The goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to deny Nathan Fraser (Wolves) as he jumps for a header from a brilliant cross into the penalty area.
87' A cross into the box from Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) is cleared.
85' The manager makes a subsitution with Shandon Baptiste (Brentford) coming on for Vitaly Janelt.
85' Thomas Frank has decided to substitute Christian Norgaard and he is replaced by Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford).
83' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
83' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Nelson Semedo as he is replaced by Matt Doherty (Wolves).
81' Simon Hooper shows a yellow card to Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) for a tough tackle.
79' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
77' 0 - 2 Goal! Ivan Toney (Brentford) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Vitaly Janelt, then sends the ball inside the left post. 0:2.
76' The game has come to an end for Neal Maupay. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford).
76' Pedro Neto (Wolves) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
75' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
74' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Nathan Fraser (Wolves), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
73' The goalkeeper dives to deny Ivan Toney (Brentford), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post.
72' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mark Flekken, who smothers the ball.
70' Nathan Fraser (Wolves) was probably a bit loose with his words to Simon Hooper, who decides to show him a yellow.
70' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mathias Jensen leaves the pitch and Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) comes on.
68' A yellow card for a tackle by Mathias Jensen (Brentford). Simon Hooper doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
67' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
66' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Mark Flekken easily deals with the threat.

66' A free kick is awarded from a very dangerous distance. It's situated just a few metres from outside the box. Several players gather around the ball, but it seems like Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) is going to have a crack himself.
62' Gary O'Neil prepares a substitution. Joao Gomes is replaced by Thomas Doyle (Wolves).
62' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header way over the bar. What a poor effort.
62' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Wolves.
60' Mark Flekken (Brentford) earns the yellow card.
60' The corner is swung in but Brentford can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
59' Pedro Neto (Wolves) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
57' The ball has crossed the sideline. Brentford are taking a throw-in.
54' The ball is cleared after Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
53' The goal by Wolves is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
52' Wait! Referee Simon Hooper has indicated he is going to review the Wolves goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
50' The referee blows his whistle, Wolves are awarded a corner kick.

50' Pedro Neto (Wolves) got in a good shooting position on the edge of the box and pulled the trigger. The ball flew towards the right side of the goal, but Mark Flekken punched it onto the post. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Wolves.
50' Craig Dawson (Wolves) heads the ball inside the left post after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.
50' The free kick from long range, taken by Brentford, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
47' Pedro Neto (Wolves) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
46' Half-time substitution. Toti is replaced by Nathan Fraser (Wolves).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' The corner from Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) is hurriedly cleared.
45+1' Mario Lemina (Wolves) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' The possession of the ball – 66:34.
44' Pedro Neto (Wolves) jumped for a header from a cross inside the box, but the goalkeeper denies his effort as it bounces off his gloves and hits the post.
42' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Toti (Wolves), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
40' The resulting corner from Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
39' The resulting set piece from Wolves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
39' A lofted cross from Pedro Neto (Wolves) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
37' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
35' 0 - 1 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Christian Norgaard (Brentford) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header perfectly into the right side of the goal. He makes it 0:1.
35' The ball is out of play and Brentford manage to earn a corner.

32' Neal Maupay (Brentford) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Jose Sa anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the middle of the target.
31' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Pedro Neto (Wolves) but poses no threat.
30' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
30' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball goes out of play and Wolves have been awarded a corner kick.
29' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
28' Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Simon Hooper signals.
27' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
26' Simon Hooper blows his whistle and it's Pedro Neto (Wolves) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
26' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) hits a piledriver from long range, but the effort curls well wide of the right post.
26' Pedro Neto (Wolves) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
24' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brentford, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
24' It looks like Max Kilman (Wolves) saw red with that tackle. Simon Hooper won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
21' Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar.
20' Matheus Cunha is substituted due to injury. Gary O'Neil gives a chance to Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves).
18' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
15' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Matheus Cunha (Wolves) causes Mark Flekken little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.

13' What a great chance for Neal Maupay (Brentford). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header towards the foot of the right post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
13' Brentford have been awarded a corner kick.
12' Neal Maupay (Brentford) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Jose Sa makes a smart save to deny him.
10' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
9' The cross into the penalty area from Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
7' Brentford control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
5' Ivan Toney (Brentford) latched on to a lofted pass inside the box, but his header misses to the right of the target.
5' Brentford take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
4' Brentford quickly take the free kick with a short pass.
4' One of the Wolves players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
2' Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
1' The first half has started.
Brentford will kick the game off.
